The dependent action requires one uniquely bound target under the reviewed selector-ambiguity policy.

claim: Selector cardinality other than one is a terminal ambiguity boundary for the reviewed dependent cut; it is not evidence for generic face recovery.

runtime_action: If and only if the declared selector observation reports cardinality other than one, do not bind a target, do not attempt the dependent action, and stop with the existing selector_ambiguous policy. This experimental card is not mounted, injected, or retrieved by default.

validation.review_trigger: Re-review before any selector scope, cardinality predicate, repair route, retrieval experiment, or runtime promotion changes.
